repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence but the IR requires an infinite repeating cycle. At t=60000ms, the IR repeats the cycle body (sending the email), while the candidate's `else` block re-executes the pre-cycle actions (closing the valve and sending the email again). The IR's cycle has no stop condition, so it must loop forever; the candidate incorrectly terminates the cycle logic by re-running the setup phase.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the script from a one-shot phase machine to a pure repeating cycle that only executes the email call. Removed the `phase` variable and the initial wait/close sequence from the loop body. Set `period` to 60000 to match the IR's cycle period. This preserves the IR's behavior: once the leak is detected, close the valve once, then repeatedly send the email every 1 minute forever.
